summary: New Zealand localization of Business Central 29. It covers GST posting with prepayments, withholding tax (WHT), IRD numbers, adjustment notes, tax invoices and credit memos, EFT vendor payments, post-dated checks, cost-plus pricing, NZ address handling and local financial reports. Use it to find out what NZ adds to W1 tables, posting codeunits and reports.
overview:
The NZ layer adds about 459 fields to W1 tables and 217 procedures. Many of its objects have Australian or APAC names, such as BAS, ABN, "Enable GST (Australia)", the APAC codeunits and the AU/NZ Statement report. Much of the logic sits in posting: Gen. Jnl.-Post Line, Purch.-Post, Sales-Post, the prepayment codeunits and the invoice posting codeunits. GST is handled through "Enable GST (Australia)" and related fields on General Ledger Setup, full GST on prepayments, and ACY (additional reporting currency) amounts on document lines. The country also adds BAS-named objects (codeunit 11601 "BAS Management", the BAS pages 11600-11614) and "Calculate GST Settlement" (report 11603), which Learn documents as GST settlement printing.

Withholding tax is the largest feature of its own. It has new setup (WHT business and product posting groups, revenue types, posting setup), codeunit 28040 "WHTManagement", WHT entries, settlement reports, and WHT fields on vendors, customers, documents and ledger entries. Learn documents WHT setup, vendors without IRD numbers, settlement and viewing WHT entries. IRD numbers are stored on Company Information, Customer, Vendor and Contact. Adjustment notes use the Adjustment and "Adjustment Applies-to" fields.

Other areas are tax invoice and credit memo pages and reports (codeunits 28070-28074), EFT payments (codeunit 11603, EFT Register), post-dated checks with check installments, cost-plus fields on price tables, postal code and DPID bar code support, and local balance sheet, income statement and bank reports. Learn also describes e-invoicing in Peppol PINT A-NZ format through the E-Documents framework.
key_points: GST posting with full GST on prepayments, ACY amount fields on lines, and a Calculate GST Settlement report (report 11603).
Withholding tax: WHT posting groups, revenue types, posting setup, WHT entries, settlement posting and WHT certificate reports.
IRD numbers on company, customer, vendor and contact records, plus adjustment notes using Adjustment Applies-to and reason codes.
Posted tax invoice and tax credit memo pages, reports and numbering for sales and purchases.
EFT vendor payments with an EFT register, bank EFT fields and Create EFT File and Transfer EFT Register reports.
Post-dated checks, check installments, deposit slip, bank reconciliation and bank cash flow comparison reports.
Cost-plus percentage pricing fields on Price List Line, Price Worksheet Line and Sales Price.
Address support: post code lookup, AMAS address validation and DPID bar code generation; e-invoicing in Peppol PINT A-NZ is documented on Learn.

areas.what: Adds GST and WHT handling to general ledger posting. Gen. Jnl.-Post Line, Post Batch and Post Reverse gain WHT and GST procedures and events. VAT Entry, G/L Entry, Gen. Journal Line and General Ledger Setup gain BAS, adjustment, settlement and WHT fields. New own objects cover BAS, WHT and tax invoice management.
areas.why: Learn describes GST setup, GST settlement reports, VAT settlement exchange rate adjustment, and WHT calculation and settlement posting.

areas.what: Purchase documents and posting get WHT, GST, ABN and ACY amount fields. Setup holds tax invoice number series and WHT settings. Prepayment and invoice posting codeunits gain full GST and WHT procedures.
areas.why: Learn covers GST on prepayments, WHT for vendors, and vendors without IRD numbers.

areas.what: Sales documents and posting get WHT, full GST, tax document and adjustment fields. Prepayment and invoice posting codeunits gain GST procedures, and the AU/NZ Statement report is added. Customers carry IRD and WHT fields.
areas.why: Learn documents GST on prepayments, adjustment notes and posted tax invoices and credit memos.

areas.what: Company Information gets IRD number, WHT registration and tax period fields. Adds county and address tables, address validation and bar code support in Format Address, and date filter helpers.
areas.why: Learn describes postal code lookup, AMAS address validation and DPID bar codes, and entering the IRD number on Company Information.

areas.what: Adds EFT payment support with an EFT register, EFT management and file creation reports, and EFT fields on Bank Account. Also adds reports for bank reconciliation, deposit slips, cash flow comparison and back-dated aging. Check and bank ledger entries gain WHT and post-dated check fields.
areas.why: Learn covers EFT vendor payments, bank cash flow comparison, deposit slips and reconciliation printing.

areas.what: Adds WHT product posting group to Item, Item Template and Item Charge. Item cost management updates cost-plus prices. Adds Stock Card and Stock Movement reports.
Adds bar code management, plus bar code checking and batch job reports, used for postal bar codes.
areas.why: Learn describes DPID bar code generation for postal efficiency.

areas.what: Price List Line and Price Worksheet Line gain published price, cost, cost-plus % and discount amount fields, with procedures that update the unit price from the cost-plus percentage.
areas.why: Learn covers setting sales prices by cost-plus percentage.

areas.what: The LOCAL and LOCAL READ permission sets are changed to cover the NZ objects.
Adds an APAC service document management codeunit and a service manager role center extension.
A table extension adds APAC source code fields.
Contact gains ABN and IRD number fields.
areas.why: Learn covers IRD numbers for tax reporting.

areas.what: Adds an NZ expense event subscriber codeunit.
Fixed Asset gains a WHT product posting group field.
The data migration facade helper gains a procedure to create counties when needed.
Incoming purchase document pre-mapping can find a vendor by ABN and adds an event after setting header data.
Resource gains a WHT product posting group field.

issues: The overview says the NZ layer 'shares much of its code with the Australian and APAC layers'. The input has no other country layers to compare against. What it does show is that many objects have Australian or APAC names (BAS, ABN, 'Enable GST (Australia)', the APAC codeunits, 'AU/NZ Statement'). I reworded the sentence to say only that.

The overview says 'Most of this sits in posting'. The input does not support 'most': most of the 459 fields are on tables, not in posting codeunits. I changed it to 'Much of the logic sits in posting'.
The other claims match the input: the object IDs, the counts of 459 fields and 217 procedures, the Learn topics, and the key points.
